title: Tundra Clover
body:
Description

The Tundra Clover was a limited time tree that was found in the colder area on Finlay Island with bluer grass along with tree types like Spruce and Blue Pine during the Saint Patrick's Day event. It is like all other clovers, but has a very blue outside with a lighter and bluer green when sawed and planked.

Trivia

  • As of version v.1.54.0 (04/14/23), the tree was brought back to permanently stay in the game.
